claim: At a7a71921de, Effect.isEffect is typed (u: unknown) => u is Effect<unknown, unknown, unknown>, so passing it directly as an S.declare guard for Effect<Success, Failure, Dependencies> in @beep/schema EffectSchema no longer type-checks.
At a7a71921de, Stream.scan takes its initial state as a LazyArg, so Stream.scan("", f) in @beep/repo-ai-metrics source-discovery.ts fails to type-check.

At a7a71921de, McpServer.layerHttp converts a POST response to text/event-stream Server-Sent Events when the request is a subscription, the RPC response body is a Stream, or the buffered body contains more than one newline-separated message; this conversion was introduced by commit a2c4154cf8 (#7265).

The professional-desktop ontology MCP integration harness uses RpcClient.layerProtocolHttp with RpcSerialization.layerJsonRpc() and an accept header of application/json, text/event-stream, so it cannot decode SSE-framed MCP responses from a snapshot server.
